system.description:
When casting a Ninjutsu that summons or creates a construct or structure, your control allows you far more flexibility. You gain the following benefits:

When you cast a Ninjutsu you know that creates a construct weapon, you can downcast it, reducing its cost by 3 and reducing the step of its damage die by 1 step for each rank it is downcast, down to a minimum of D-Rank. If cast in this way, it gains the Stable or Efficient keyword, pick one.

Ninjutsu you cast that summons a wall or structure, increases the height and length of the wall or structure by 10 feet.

Evocation Technique – Polymerization. While wielding a Combat Scroll, when you summon a construct creature, you can select a separate jutsu you know that summons a different construct creature. Select one of their features or attacks. The creature you summoned gains the chosen feature or attack.
system.requirement: Have a Ninjutsu that creates or summons constructs or structures on your known list.
